questions.question: What was Confucius's birth name?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Confucius was born Kong Qiu.
Incorrect. Kong He was Confucius's father, not his birth name.
Incorrect. Zhongni was Confucius's courtesy name, not his birth name.
Incorrect. Kong Li was Confucius's son, not Confucius himself.

questions.question: Which period of Chinese history did Confucius live in?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article identifies Confucius as a philosopher of the Spring and Autumn period.
Incorrect. The Warring States period came after Confucius's lifetime, though his ideas gained prominence then.
Incorrect. The Qin dynasty followed Confucius's time and caused setbacks to his ideas.
Incorrect. The Han dynasty came later and gave official sanction to Confucian ideas.

questions.question: What did Confucius champion as a negative form of the Golden Rule?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Confucius championed the Silver Rule, advising 'Do not do unto others what you do not want done to yourself.'
Incorrect. The Bronze Rule is not mentioned in the article.
Incorrect. The Iron Rule is not mentioned in the article.
Incorrect. The Steel Rule is not mentioned in the article.

questions.question: Which emperor gave official sanction to Confucius's ideas?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that under Emperor Wu of Han, Confucius's ideas received official sanction.
Incorrect. The Qin dynasty caused setbacks to Confucian ideas, including the burning of books.
Incorrect. The Tang dynasty saw the development of Neo-Confucianism, but official sanction came earlier under Emperor Wu of Han.
Incorrect. The Song dynasty also contributed to Neo-Confucianism, but official sanction came earlier under Emperor Wu of Han.

questions.question: Where was Confucius born?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Confucius was born on 28 September 551 BCE, in Zou, in modern Qufu, Shandong.
Incorrect. Lu was the state that effectively controlled the area, but not the specific birthplace named.
Incorrect. Song was the state his ancestry traced back to, not his birthplace.
Incorrect. The Shang dynasty was an earlier dynasty linked to his ancestry, not a birthplace.

questions.question: How old was Confucius when his father died?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Kong He died when Confucius was three years old.
Incorrect. Nineteen is when Confucius married Qi Guanshi.
Incorrect. Twenty-three is when Confucius's mother died and he mourned for three years.
Incorrect. Sixty-eight is when Confucius returned home to Lu.

questions.question: What position did Confucius eventually rise to in the Lu government?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Confucius eventually rose to the position of Minister of Crime.
Incorrect. Governor of a town was a minor position he held earlier, not the highest he rose to.
Incorrect. Prime Minister was held by the head of the Ji family, not Confucius.
Incorrect. Minister of War was held by the head of the Shu family, not Confucius.

questions.question: In what year did Confucius depart his homeland of Lu?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Confucius departed his homeland in 497 BCE after the failed attempt to dismantle fortified city walls.
Incorrect. 501 BCE is when Confucius was appointed governor of a town.
Incorrect. 500 BCE is when Hou Fan revolted against his lord of the Shu family.
Incorrect. 498 BCE is when the Shu family tore down the walls of Hou and other wall-dismantling events occurred.

questions.question: At what age did Confucius die?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states Confucius died at the age of 71 or 72 from natural causes.
Incorrect. 68 is when Confucius returned home to Lu, not when he died.
Incorrect. 73 is not mentioned as Confucius's age at death.
Incorrect. 70 is not mentioned as Confucius's age at death.
